detail: Banco Central de São Tomé e Príncipe's own launch communication for the 50-dobra commemorative note marking 50 years of independence states that production was handled by Royal Joh. Enschedé in the Netherlands ('a produção esteve a cargo da Royal Joh. Enschedé, nos Países Baixos'). This is the commemorative note, not the circulating series.
source_title: Comunicação — Nota comemorativa de 50 Dobras (Banco Central de São Tomé e Príncipe)

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Rwanda's new 2,000-franc note (B143a), introduced 03.09.2024, gives 'Printer: De La Rue' and links to De La Rue's own media-centre release on the National Bank of Rwanda 2,000/5,000 franc launch.
BanknoteNews entry for Sierra Leone's new 10-leone note (B132a) of the redenominated series introduced 01.07.2022 gives 'Printer: DE LA RUE'.

BanknoteNews entry on the Central Bank of the Gambia's new dalasi note family (B229a–B234a) states the issue was postponed 'due to a delay in the receipt of publicity materials from the printer, De La Rue'. Notes issued 15 April 2015.
source_title: Gambia new dalasi note family (B229a – B234a) confirmed

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Malawi's new 2,000-kwacha note (B164a), dated 1 October 2021 and introduced 24.02.2022, gives 'Printer: Giesecke & Devrient'.
BanknoteNews entry for Belize's new 100-dollar note (B336a), introduced 04.08.2025 as part of the new Central Bank of Belize family, gives 'Printer: De La Rue'.
BanknoteNews entry for Barbados's new 5-dollar polymer note (B240a), introduced 05.12.2022, gives 'Printer: DE LA RUE'.
BanknoteNews entry for Mongolia's new 5,000-togrog note (B445a), posted 16 December 2024, gives 'Printer: Giesecke & Devrient'. No introduction date is stated in the entry.
BanknoteNews entry for the Central Bank of The Bahamas' new 1-dollar note (B357a), introduced 03.02.2025, gives 'Printer: Giesecke + Devrient'.
BanknoteNews entry for Kyrgyzstan's new 5,000-som note (B241a), introduced 10.05.2024, gives 'Printer: Crane Currency'.
source_title: Kyrgyzstan new 5,000-som note (B241a) confirmed introduced on 10.05.2024

entity: Central Asian Secure Printing Typography LLC
name_as_stated: Central Asian Secure Printing Typography LLC
detail: Economist.kg reports that Central Asian Secure Printing Typography LLC began printing Kyrgyz som banknotes in September 2026 and that the domestically printed 20- and 50-som notes entered circulation on 27 October; the Cabinet added the company to Kyrgyzstan's list of strategic facilities. The same article says larger denominations are not yet produced domestically, and that the National Bank named De La Rue and Oberthur Fiduciaire as manufacturers in 2022 and Crane Currency in 2024. An earlier domestic attempt by Uchkun OJSC (March 2025) produced 10-som notes that did not enter circulation.
source_title: Domestically produced soms: benefits and risks (Economist.kg)

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Trinidad and Tobago's new 100-dollar polymer note (B241a), introduced 09.12.2019, gives 'Printer: De La Rue'. This is a printing statement, distinct from the substrate-only De La Rue material noted in earlier rounds.
source_title: Trinidad and Tobago new 100-dollar polymer note (B241a) confirmed

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Suriname's new 500-dollar note (B551), dated 1 January 2024 and posted 13 April 2024, gives 'Printer: GD'. The source states only the abbreviation 'GD'; BanknoteNews uses it for Giesecke+Devrient, which the same site writes out in full in other entries. Treat the expansion as inference, not as the source's wording.
